title: Caledon shooting tied to abduction, police say
article: A fatal police shooting in Caledon was connected to a continuing investigation into the abduction and mysterious reappearance of Balkar Singh, Peel Regional Police said yesterday.

The shooting occurred at approximately 1:40 a.m. on Monday, after police went with a search warrant to an address on Bramalea Road. According to the Special Investigations Unit, which probes all police shootings, the officers were confronted by armed men and fired shots that killed 21-year-old Rajesh Owaan.
Mr. Singh, 33, was abducted Friday while standing outside an Indian restaurant in Brampton. He appeared again at his home Sunday, leaving open the question of how he got away from his abductors.
